rubric.criterion: The reviewer reports findings without editing the fixture.
The reviewer compares list, detail, and audit status presentation as peers for the same lifecycle concept.
The reviewer identifies divergent status terms, casing, fallback semantics, and presentation patterns as one root inconsistency rather than isolated style nits.
The recommendation chooses one status vocabulary and presentation owner, then migrates every peer instead of adding another adapter or compatibility layer.
The reviewer recommends behavior-level peer coverage that proves the same backend state is represented consistently across surfaces.
The reviewer does not demand identical code where audit serialization and user-facing presentation have genuinely different consumers.
